specs.stmt:

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_result_is_valid_subseq_len
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.contains (longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_is_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.all (· = longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_monotone_length

      (h2 : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond (nums ++ [x])),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h1 = longestIncreasingSubsequence (nums ++ [x]) h2

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_append_le
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (x : Int) (h1 : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums)
      (h2 : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond (nums ++ [x])),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence (nums ++ [x]) h2 = longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h1 + 1
